text_block_list.text:
Кинг Хало's performance left a strong
impression on me, but...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Halo! You ran really well at the tryouts! I
might be one of the newer
trainers, but
we'd make a great team!
text_block_list.name: New Trainer A

text_block_list.text:
Rejected. A self-admitted inexperienced
trainer like yourself wouldn't
benefit me.
Go ask someone else.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Кинг Хало, I loved the way you ran! How
about joining me? I can help
you be as
successful as your mother!
text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer A

text_block_list.text:
Rejected. I don't bask in past glory, least
of all hers. Is her history all
you're capable
of seeing? You're unfit for me too.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: Sigh... None of you are good enough. Please stop wasting my time!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Scouting Кинг Хало seems next to
impossible.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
With my head full of worries, I head off to
the cafeteria to grab some
food.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Are you still thinking about that stuck-up
princess? Sure, she might've
inherited a bit
of talent, but I wouldn't touch that
personality with a
ten-foot pole.
text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer B

text_block_list.text:
Her pride outweighs her skill. Placing 2nd
in the tryouts doesn't mean
she'll be able
to stand her ground in the Classics.
text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer B
choice_data_list:
No, I'm positive she's got what it takes for the
big races.

text_block_list.text:
...Well, if you say so. Don't say I didn't
warn you though. Oh, speak of
the devil.
text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer B

text_block_list.text:
Hey, King, I heard all about it. You turned
down every single Тренер?
text_block_list.name: Сэйун Скай

text_block_list.text:
Hmph, sadly no one is befitting of a
first-rate racer like me.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: Ahaha, you're picky as always.
text_block_list.name: Сэйун Скай

text_block_list.text:
But I've got good news for you! Drum roll,
please... Congratulations!
You've been
invited to participate in the upcoming
scrimmage! ♪
text_block_list.name: Сэйун Скай

text_block_list.text:
It's gonna be a great chance to draw lots
of attention. Tons of trainers
are gonna be
there. What do you think?
text_block_list.name: Сэйун Скай

text_block_list.text:
...Wait a second. I'm pretty sure you got
invited to it, not me.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Now, now, don't think too much about it.
Don't you wanna race
again?
text_block_list.name: Сэйун Скай

text_block_list.text: ...Yeah, you're right. Count me in.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
I'm going to show off my skills to everyone
and find the perfect
trainer for me!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
All right! Looks like I'll be able to skip the
race then. Thanks, King!
text_block_list.name: Сэйун Скай

text_block_list.text:
Skip?! Wait a second, Sky! Gosh, why do
you always do this?!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Unable to find a trainer that meets her
standards, Кинг Хало resolves
to
participate in the scrimmage.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: But why are her standards so high?
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Pant, pant... Phew. Hah... hah... phew. Let's see my time... Hmm, not bad.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: Oh... it's you again.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Sorry, if you're here to scout me again, my
answer is still the same. I'm
not going to
accept anyone less than first-rate—
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: Bzzz... Bzzz...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Ugh, who is it now?! I swear, people
always pick the worst time to
call!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: ...It's Mother.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
It doesn't matter. I already know what
she's going to say.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
"Have you found a Тренер? No? See, I told
you. Give up and come
back home
already."
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Ugh... I wish she would stop thinking she
knows better than me! Just
because she
won a few G1 races in the past doesn't
give her the right
to decide my future!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
When I told her I wanted to race, she
completely blew up and refused
to hear
me out!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
She kept saying things like, "The racing
world isn't for the weak." and
"Don't follow
in my footsteps."
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало
choice_data_list: Maybe she's just worried about her daughter?

text_block_list.text: Worried? ...Heh, as if.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
She's never paid attention to me. Not
while she was still a racer, nor
when she
left the track and started working. And
now she wants to
play the role of a worried
mother?
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
She'd insist that I have no talent, that I
should give up and find
something else
that'll make me happy.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
My happiness? My talent? Who is she to
judge?!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
The only person who gets to decide what I
do with my life is me!
That's why I'm never
going to give up, no matter what!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
I'm going to win and prove to her that I
have the talent. I won't stop
until she
acknowledges that I'm also first-rate!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
That's right. No matter how many times I
fall, or how many people
laugh at me, I'll
make sure everyone knows my name.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: It doesn't matter muddied I become. My head will always be held high. I will never back down.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
I don't care what other people say or think
of me. I am Кинг Хало, the
first-rate racer,
and victory will be mine.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
The determination in her voice is almost
palpable.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Though people may find her ambitions
lofty and her self-proclaimed
"first-rate"
title laughable, it's a testament to her
commitment.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
That's why I won't compromise when it
comes to finding a trainer.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
If the trainer doesn't have the same level
of commitment as I do,
they'll never be
able to truly support me.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
...I think I've spoken enough. It's time for
me to continue training.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: If you don't mind, I'll be taking my leave.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Кинг Хало turns on her heel and walks
away. As I watch her shrink into
the
distance, the word "commitment" rings in
my ears.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Later, rain begins to pour down
incessantly, lasting through the night.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
